diseases.name: Cryptogenic organizing pneumonia (COP)
diseases.pathology_and_diagnostic_discriminator: Intra-alveolar fibroblastic Masson bodies, preserved architecture; secondary organizing pneumonia must be excluded.
diseases.treatment_summary: Corticosteroids for selected symptomatic cases; recognize relapse and steroid risks.
diseases.source_data: Detailed 15-field authored profile is in Run002 downloadable DOCX and source ZIP; full binary not durably archived in Library

diseases.name: Nonspecific interstitial pneumonia (NSIP) pattern / idiopathic NSIP
diseases.pathology_and_diagnostic_discriminator: Temporally uniform cellular or fibrotic septal disease versus heterogeneous UIP; etiologic CTD/drug evaluation.
diseases.treatment_summary: Treat underlying CTD/trigger; immunomodulation for selected inflammatory disease, nintedanib if progressive fibrosis criteria.
diseases.source_data: Detailed 15-field authored profile is in Run002 downloadable DOCX and source ZIP; full binary not durably archived in Library

diseases.name: Hypersensitivity pneumonitis (HP)
diseases.pathology_and_diagnostic_discriminator: Antigen-linked airway-centered lymphocytic inflammation ± poorly formed granulomas; fibrotic and nonfibrotic subtypes.
diseases.treatment_summary: Identify/avoid antigen; selective immunosuppression; antifibrotic for progressive fibrotic phenotype as appropriate.
diseases.source_data: Detailed 15-field authored profile is in Run002 downloadable DOCX and source ZIP; full binary not durably archived in Library

diseases.name: Pulmonary alveolar proteinosis (PAP)
diseases.pathology_and_diagnostic_discriminator: Surfactant-rich PAS-positive airspace filling from impaired GM-CSF macrophage signaling; autoimmune vs secondary/hereditary.
diseases.treatment_summary: Expert-center whole lung lavage and inhaled GM-CSF for symptomatic autoimmune PAP; treat cause of secondary PAP.
diseases.source_data: Detailed 15-field authored profile is in Run002 downloadable DOCX and source ZIP; full binary not durably archived in Library

diseases.name: Lymphangioleiomyomatosis (LAM)
diseases.pathology_and_diagnostic_discriminator: TSC1/TSC2 mTORC1 activation, diffuse round thin-wall cysts, LAM cells HMB-45/SMA positive; VEGF-D supportive.
diseases.treatment_summary: Sirolimus for abnormal/declining function; pneumothorax pleural management; transplant for advanced cases.
diseases.source_data: Detailed 15-field authored profile is in Run002 downloadable DOCX and source ZIP; full binary not durably archived in Library

diseases.name: Pulmonary Langerhans cell histiocytosis (PLCH)
diseases.pathology_and_diagnostic_discriminator: Smoking-associated CD1a/langerin positive MAPK-pathway myeloid neoplasm; nodules plus upper-zone irregular cysts.
diseases.treatment_summary: Smoking cessation; specialist targetable pathway therapy only in selected progressive molecularly defined settings.
diseases.source_data: Detailed 15-field authored profile is in Run002 downloadable DOCX and source ZIP; full binary not durably archived in Library

diseases.name: Respiratory bronchiolitis-associated interstitial lung disease (RB-ILD)
diseases.pathology_and_diagnostic_discriminator: Smoker pigmented macrophages primarily bronchiolocentric with clinical-radiographic impairment, not incidental smoker macrophages.
diseases.treatment_summary: Smoking cessation, follow-up lung function; no established routine anti-inflammatory drug.
diseases.source_data: Detailed 15-field authored profile is in Run002 downloadable DOCX and source ZIP; full binary not durably archived in Library

diseases.name: Alveolar macrophage pneumonia (AMP; formerly desquamative interstitial pneumonia)
diseases.pathology_and_diagnostic_discriminator: 2025 ERS/ATS term AMP replaces inaccurate DIP name; diffuse alveolar pigment macrophages versus RB-ILD centrilobular pattern.
diseases.treatment_summary: Remove exposure and stop smoking; selected glucocorticoids supported by weak evidence.
diseases.source_data: Detailed 15-field authored profile is in Run002 downloadable DOCX and source ZIP; full binary not durably archived in Library

diseases.name: Silicosis
diseases.pathology_and_diagnostic_discriminator: Respirable silica → macrophage injury, collagenous whorled nodules; upper-lung/eggshell nodes sometimes; TB risk.
diseases.treatment_summary: Avoid further dust, treat complications/oxygen; no established cure.
diseases.source_data: Detailed 15-field authored profile is in Run002 downloadable DOCX and source ZIP; full binary not durably archived in Library

diseases.name: Asbestosis
diseases.pathology_and_diagnostic_discriminator: Long-latency basal subpleural pulmonary fibrosis with ferruginous bodies; pleural plaques do not alone diagnose asbestosis.
diseases.treatment_summary: Exposure cessation, preventive and supportive respiratory care; monitor cancer risks.
diseases.source_data: Detailed 15-field authored profile is in Run002 downloadable DOCX and source ZIP; full binary not durably archived in Library

diseases.name: Coal workers' pneumoconiosis (CWP)
diseases.pathology_and_diagnostic_discriminator: Coal dust macrophage macules, with silica coexposure; advanced progressive massive fibrosis.
diseases.treatment_summary: Dust control, surveillance and symptom-oriented care; no cure.
diseases.source_data: Detailed 15-field authored profile is in Run002 downloadable DOCX and source ZIP; full binary not durably archived in Library

diseases.name: Acute eosinophilic pneumonia (AEP)
diseases.pathology_and_diagnostic_discriminator: Acute febrile hypoxemic airspace disease with BAL eosinophils often ≥25%; initial blood eosinophils may be normal.
diseases.treatment_summary: Remove trigger, oxygen/ICU when severe, glucocorticoids after infectious evaluation.
diseases.source_data: Detailed 15-field authored profile is in Run002 downloadable DOCX and source ZIP; full binary not durably archived in Library

diseases.name: Chronic eosinophilic pneumonia (CEP)
diseases.pathology_and_diagnostic_discriminator: Weeks-to-months peripheral opacities with eosinophilia and asthma association; frequent steroid-responsive relapses.
diseases.treatment_summary: Glucocorticoids, investigation for secondary causes, specialist steroid-sparing approaches as required.
diseases.source_data: Detailed 15-field authored profile is in Run002 downloadable DOCX and source ZIP; full binary not durably archived in Library

diseases.name: Constrictive bronchiolitis / bronchiolitis obliterans
diseases.pathology_and_diagnostic_discriminator: Concentric bronchiolar wall fibrosis narrowing small airways, air-trapping and fixed obstruction; NOT COP Masson bodies.
diseases.treatment_summary: Remove toxin/treat transplant or GVHD context; irreversible disease often requires supportive/transplant care.
diseases.source_data: Detailed 15-field authored profile is in Run002 downloadable DOCX and source ZIP; full binary not durably archived in Library
